title: MetaAligner: Towards Generalizable Multi-Objective Alignment of Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on multi-objective preference alignment for LLMs, specifically targeting human values and expectations. It evaluates models on objectives such as 'Honesty', 'Harmlessness', and 'Fairness', which are central to AI ethics and moral alignment. The inclusion of 'Fairness' and 'Honesty' as benchmarks demonstrates a direct engagement with ethical and value-based evaluations.
